Title: Insecure Direct Object Reference in profile API
Description: Changing the user_id path parameter returns another user's profile including email and phone. Tested with two accounts under authorization.
Remediation: Enforce object-level authorization server-side on every request.

Title: Server-side request forgery in webhook tester
Description: The url parameter is fetched server-side with no allowlist. Requesting the cloud metadata endpoint returned instance metadata.
Remediation: Allowlist destination hosts, resolve and validate the address, and block link-local and private ranges.

Title: JWT authorization bypass via algorithm confusion
Description: The API accepts a token whose alg header was changed to none. An unsigned token with role=admin was accepted.
Remediation: Pin the expected algorithm server-side and reject tokens that do not match.

Title: Directory listing enabled
Description: The uploads directory returns an index listing. The directory contained no files at the time of testing.

Title: Server version disclosed in response header
Remediation: Suppress version tokens in the Server header.

Title: Cookie without SameSite attribute
Description: The session cookie is set without an explicit SameSite attribute.
Remediation: Set SameSite=Lax or Strict as appropriate.
